summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Stevanato Group S.p.A. providing notice of an ordinary and extraordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for May 26, 2026. The agenda includes standard items such as approval of financial statements, dividend allocation, board appointments, auditor selection, authorization for treasury share transactions, and bylaw amendments. There are no special-situation events like mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, or activist campaigns. The filing is a regular corporate governance update with no material change in control or strategic direction.
